summary: Build the Saddam Chat app’s secure signup flow using Firebase Auth + Firestore, including required profile photo upload, first-user super_admin auto-approval logic, and post-signup routing to Pending Approval or Chat (excluding admin dashboard and security rules for now).
architectural_notes: Use Firebase Auth for account creation and Firestore users/{uid} for user profile fields: name, age, relation, phone, email, photoURL, role, approved, createdAt (server timestamp).
Role/approval bootstrap logic: if first user in users collection => role=super_admin, approved=true; else role=user, approved=false.
Post-signup routing: approved=false shows Pending Approval screen; approved=true redirects to chat screen.
Privacy requirement for admin views: only super_admin may see phone/email; helper admins and users must not see phone/email (enforced in UI; security rules explicitly deferred).
Scope constraints: do not build admin dashboard yet; do not build Firestore/Firebase security rules yet; focus only on correct signup flow.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement secure signup flow for Saddam Chat with required fields (photo upload, name, age, relation text, phone, email, password/confirm), create Auth user + Firestore users/{uid} doc, first-user super_admin auto-approval, and route to Pending Approval vs Chat with review messaging
